description: This file defines interfaces and components related to display configurations within the Cuttlefish project. It includes class declarations for sharing, parsing, and serializing display configuration data, as well as component functions for dependency injection.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigs
classes.description: Interface for sharing display configuration data, including methods to get and set configs, and to retrieve the component's name.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFlag
classes.description: Component to parse the --display command line flag and update display configurations.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFragment
classes.description: Component to serialize and deserialize display configurations to and from JSON.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the display configuration component.

methods.name: DisplaysConfigsComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component for DisplaysConfigs.

methods.name: DisplaysConfigsFlagComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component for the display configs flag and required configs.

methods.name: DisplaysConfigsFragmentComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component for display configs serialization/deserialization.
